business_overview.revenue_model: Sale of goods at a point in time.
business_notes: Products are mainly exported to America, Europe, Australia, Mainland China, Japan and Southeast Asia.
Two major customers contributed HK$186.485 million of 2023 revenue, all in the America segment.
Vietnam factory accounted for 59% of group revenue in 2023; PRC production facilities accounted for 41%.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: 2022-2023 operating cash flow exceeded profit because 2023 released inventory; 2024 later-year cross-check shows operating cash flow can fall materially when working capital normalizes. Profit is real but should be discounted for export manufacturing cyclicality, major-customer concentration and working-capital swings.

gaps: 2023 annual report does not split all cash by parent company versus each operating subsidiary; PRC and Vietnam bank deposits are disclosed only in aggregate.
